title: Proofread
summary: Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation, listing each change.

inputs.text: Their are three mistake in this sentense.

sections.use: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in a text and see each change, so the corrections can be checked.
sections.exclusions: No rewording, restyling or fact checking; use rewrite_for_audience to change tone.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 8,192 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 20,000 characters; at most 100 listed changes. Each before should appear in the original and each after in the corrected text; the evaluation checks this.
sections.missing_data: A text with nothing to correct is returned unchanged with no changes.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

outputs.changes: Each change: before, after and reason.
